name: P06 every door on the green, in and out, on foot

steps.note: 1. every door on the green points at a map that is actually registered
2. WALK OUT of all ten rooms: dismiss whatever the room says, head for the front wall, steer to the door if the first leg slid off something, and land back on the green

steps.eval: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const out=[];for(const D of window.__P06rooms){__DQ.teleport(D.room);await sleep(1500);for(let k=0;k<14&&__DQ.state().scene!=='field';k++){__DQ.press('confirm');await sleep(520);}const dx=(__DQ.state().map.spawn||{x:0}).x;let land=__DQ.state().map.id;let how='walk';for(let leg=0;leg<3&&land===D.room;leg++){__DQ.hold('down',2400);await sleep(2800);land=__DQ.state().map.id;if(land!==D.room)break;const p=__DQ.state().player;__DQ.hold(p.x<dx?'right':'left',1500);await sleep(1900);land=__DQ.state().map.id;}if(land===D.room){how='press Z at the door';const n=__DQ.state().player.near;__DQ.press('confirm');await sleep(1400);land=__DQ.state().map.id;}out.push({room:D.room,landed:land,how,ok:land==='puddlewick'});}window.__OUT=out;return JSON.stringify(out);})()

steps.note: 3. WALK IN through three doors at opposite ends of the green, from the doorstep, no teleport

steps.eval: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const out=[];for(const plot of ['puddlewick_bakery','puddlewick_chapel','hollybank_barn','puddlewick_shop']){const d=window.__P06[plot];__DQ.teleport('puddlewick',d.x,d.z);await sleep(1700);__DQ.freeze(true);__DQ.cameraOrbit(d.facing*180/Math.PI+180);__DQ.freeze(false);await sleep(500);for(let leg=0;leg<3&&__DQ.state().map.id==='puddlewick';leg++){__DQ.hold('up',1500);await sleep(2000);}out.push({plot,went:__DQ.state().map.id});}window.__IN=out;return JSON.stringify(out);})()
